name: v270_product_group_competitor_reversal
hypothesis: Competitor-relative return reversal is crowded under normal industry ranking, but ranking it inside low-use PV13 product/relationship groups may isolate product-peer mispricing and reduce correlation to existing industry-neutral competitor sleeves.
field_notes: Uses low-alphaCount PV13 grouping field pv13_rha2_min5_3000_513_sector as group input, not as a raw numeric signal. Compact replacement for v269 residual stacking.

name: v270_product_group_generic_revision
hypothesis: Low-use generic analyst estimate value changes may capture broad non-EPS revision information; comparing within product taxonomy groups should avoid direct EPS/book/CFO crowding.
field_notes: Uses rank-space change between anl4_eaz2lafv110_estvalue and anl4_eaz2lafv110_prevval; both are low-use generic estimate fields.

name: v270_product_group_sga_surprise
hypothesis: Actual SG&A below analyst expectation can indicate expense discipline; product-group ranking may make the comparison more economic than broad industry buckets.
field_notes: Uses analyst4 SG&A actual vs median estimate in rank space to avoid unit warnings and avoid direct profitability/book/debt fields.

name: v270_top1000_sga_surprise_reversal
hypothesis: The same SG&A discipline signal may be more reliable in liquid large names; a top1000 gate is a direct response to repeated LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE failures.
field_notes: Uses univ1 top1000 only as a liquidity/subuniverse gate, with a small reversal stabilizer for turnover and timing.

name: v270_product_group_mna_specific
hypothesis: Specific M&A sentiment may carry corporate-action surprise that differs from broad news attention; product taxonomy ranking plus a technical-news fade attempts to avoid the crowded broad news carrier.
field_notes: Uses low-use news18 merger_acquisition_sentiment and rp_nip_technical with PV13 grouping, staying far below the 64 operator limit.

name: v270_product_group_earnings_eval_fade
hypothesis: Earnings-evaluation sentiment may overreact within similar product groups; fading it inside product taxonomy groups tests a more specific version of the old broad editorial contrarian route.
field_notes: Small, explicit test of one low-use news18 field. If weak or high-correlated, close this specific route quickly.
